text:
Maya R.: Quick poll — the office kettle is definitely sentient, right? It only whistles when I'm running late. :tea: 
Oliver: 100% plotting. Also it's the loudest alarm clock I've ever owned. :alarm_clock: :laughing:
Zoe: We should name it. Nomi (Noise + Omni).
Samir: Team vote: Name it 'Buzzer Bean' or 'Sir Whistles-a-lot'?
Maya R.: Buzzer Bean gets my vote. Feels like a jazz musician. :saxophone:
Oliver: Sir Whistles-a-lot is regal, but Buzzer Bean is chef's kiss. :ok_hand:
Zoe: Can we get a tiny top hat and monocle for Sir Whistles-a-lot? Asking for a kettle.
Samir: Also low-stakes poll — who wants toast tomorrow morning? I'll bring a toaster if we put a sticker on the kettle. :bread:
Maya R.: I will bring jam if @Oliver brings butter. Deal?
Oliver: Deal. I'll bring butter and dubious enthusiasm.
CoffeeBot: Reminder: Free drip coffee in the kitchen until 11am. :coffee: (Provided by Facilities)
Zoe: CoffeeBot = real MVP.
Samir: Micro-kudos for Facilities — kitchen has been immaculate this week. :sparkles:
Maya R.: Kudos echoed. Quick one-liners while we wait for the kettle: "I came, I saw, I caf-feinated." 
Oliver: "Espresso yourself." 
Zoe: "Bean there, done that."
Samir: "Don't worry, be frappé"
Maya R.: OK that's enough puns for the day. See you at the kettle ceremony 9:45am. :tada:
